decisions.reason: The request to handle two additional budgets may imply extending the support-sheet deliverable to those sites, but the source does not explicitly request salary and wages support sheets for them.
The candidate already records the two allocated-budget values from message 24; correcting weeks served does not alter those budget values.
The candidate already records the start and end dates supplied in message 24, and the weeks-served correction does not necessarily change those schedule fields.
The site-name relationship is independently established by the same message and remains unchanged by the weeks-served correction.
The candidate already establishes weeks_served as 4 from the same source message, so an additional propagated MODIFY would duplicate the existing state change.
Message 24 does not change the signature requirement or extend its scope to the additional sites.
The weeks-served correction and additional site figures do not change the existing explanation concerning the difference between a full allocation and a subcontract amount.
